column1: # Golden cases for the user pronunciation overrides (DemaConsulting.Speech.Text.En.Tests).
# They run against overrides-dictionary.tsv, through the real tokenizer and the real normalizer.
# Columns (tab separated; '#' lines and blank lines are ignored; the first other line is the header):
#   id        unique row name, quoted in failure messages
#   input     the text; escapes: \t \n \r \uXXXX \\ (a tag placeholder is \uFFFC and is spoken as a space)
#   spoken    the input with every replacement (en.norm and en.spell) applied (same escapes)
#   pron      the pronunciation marks as source=value, joined by U+00A6; '-' for none
#   spelled   the source text of every spelled (en.spell) replacement, joined by U+00A6; '-' for none
#   applied   the expected number of overrides applied
#   ignored   the expected number of overrides ignored (their token was consumed by an earlier match)
